findings.text: Exposes a predicate that reports whether the current platform includes any UV hub variant.
Defines a 64 bit APIC identity view that can be read as one integer or as two parallel decode groups for local APIC and partition node, each with mask width, shift width and reserved padding.
Partition node derives from network identifier with configured shift and mask, while network identifier is rebuilt by merging global extra bits into the partition node and shifting back.

Per generation windows use local base 0xfa000000 with 32 MiB on UV2 through UV5; 32 bit global window uses base 0xfc000000 with 32 MiB on UV2 and UV3 and zero base and size on UV4 and UV5; generic selectors resolve by active generation and yield zero otherwise.

Global 64 bit base and its partition shift come from hub state, GRU base is 0x4000000, 32 bit partition field starts at bit 15, legacy 64 bit shift is 26, and hub APIC register offset is 0x002D0E00 with partition shift 6.
Local bus starts at 0x1c00000 with 4 MiB extent; controller interface reserves 64 trailing bytes, with heartbeat flag 0x01, activity flag 0x02 and heartbeat interval of one HZ period.
Offers an iteration construct that walks blade identifiers from zero up to but excluding the current possible blade count.
Exposes the configured global address shift held in hub state.
Locates the address range record for a physical address by masking and shifting to a key and returning the first table entry whose limit exceeds that key.
Range lookup failure is fatal: the implementation reports the missing address and table position and then halts instead of returning a fallback.
Derives a range base by following the located record to its base slot and returning the referenced limit, or zero when the indicator is negative.
Provides conversions from socket physical address to network identifier and from kernel virtual pointer to network identifier or global address through physical translation and range lookup.

Physical to global translation applies low memory remap when below the remap top, then either merges upper bits with field shuffling when mode is nonzero or inserts the network identifier at the global shift otherwise.
Global addresses whose top two bits are both set are classified as memory mapped register space.
Reverse translation undoes mode dependent shuffling when enabled, masks to the address field, then removes the low memory remap base when inside the remapped interval.

Node decoding uses the upper field directly when node shift is configured and otherwise falls back to range lookup; partition masks that result and offset uses direct masking or range base subtraction.
Socket to node and partition to socket translations consult optional hub tables with bias correction and degrade to identity when the table pointer is absent.
Partition plus offset maps to virtual address either by direct shift and merge when mode is set or by socket lookup with range table base, using zero base for socket zero.
APIC to partition conversion shifts by the configured APIC shift then optionally remaps through the socket table with minimum socket bias.
Global 32 bit, global 64 bit and local windows expose address constructors combining window base with positioned partition bits and offset, plus paired quad and byte read and write accessors.

Topology helpers expose current and per CPU blade processor numbers, blade to node, blade identity, node to blade, CPU to blade, blade to partition, blade to memory node and CPU counts, CPU to partition, node to partition and total possible blades.
BIOS scratch register and two aliases anchor TSC sync and NMI signaling; TSC uses shift 10 with alternate 16, mask 3, valid 3 and unknown 0; NMI uses shift 63 with clear alias and SCRATCH5 label.

Hub NMI block holds a spinlock, atomics for presence in NMI, owner, read count and true count, last value and presence and ownership flags; CPU block links to its hub and holds state plus ping and query counters.
Each hub NMI block carries its own raw spinlock for serializing NMI register handling alongside atomics, with no sleeping synchronization shown.
CPU NMI progress moves among outside handling, inside handling, dumping state and dump complete.
Current hub NMI pointer comes from the local CPU record with per CPU variants, and hub revision reports the minimum revision from hub state.
IO APIC route entry packs vector, delivery and destination modes, status, polarity, trigger, mask, reserved gaps and 32 bit destination into 64 bits; affinity scope orders all, node and CPU levels.

Generations are single bits UV2 1, UV3 2, UV4 4, UV4A 8 and UV5 16, grouped as UVX for 2 to 4 and UVY for 5 with all bits meaning any; enable uses top bit 63; part numbers are UV1 0x88a5, UV2 0x8eb8 with alt 0x1111, UV3 0x9578 with alt 0x4321, UV4 0x99a1 and UV5 0xa171.

Event register 0 sits at 0x70000; listed hard and address error fields each use one bit with matching shift and single bit mask across local, remote, link, graphics, network and crossbar blocks at shifts 0 and 2 to 16 with gaps.
Both UV IRQ and MMR headers define single inclusion guards.
